feed.headline: Protesters blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis
feed.ai: Hundreds have pitched their tents in central Madrid, while the Spanish prime minister has called a snap election.

feed.headline: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
feed.ai: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says the move will deliver more stable government, but opposition parties say her aim is to stay in power.
feed.frag: Highlights the limits of national coordination

feed.headline: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election
feed.ai: Calling of a snap election was not a knee-jerk reaction from Pedro Sánchez but a carefully thought-out manoeuvre, Guy Hedgecoe reports from Madrid.

feed.headline: Ukraine Peace Talks Sputter After Trump and Putin Strike Fuel Deal
feed.ai: Hours after President Trump said the United States would buy Russian diesel, the Kremlin said there would be no immediate resumption of discussions to end the war.
feed.frag: Highlights the limits of national coordination

feed.headline: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
feed.ai: Often dubbed "Russia's Google", the tech firm admits customers may experience disruption to digital services due to the attacks.

feed.headline: Russian strikes and approaching winter force some in Kyiv to pack bags and flee
feed.ai: A renewed Russian campaign of strikes on power and energy infrastructure has made some contemplate leaving Ukraine's capital.

feed.headline: UK and Germany will face threats together, says Burnham in Berlin
feed.ai: Ahead of a UK-EU summit next month, Burnham said he was committed to "see if we can bring the UK closer to Europe".

feed.headline: 'Come all the way' back to EU, French finance minister tells UK
feed.ai: Roland Lescure tells the BBC that being in the bloc enables members to better address the challenges facing the world.

feed.headline: Deniz Goktas, Jailed in Turkey for a Joke, Delivers a Bold Defense in Court
feed.ai: Facing 19 months in prison, Deniz Goktas says in an interview that he made his bold statement as a way to show what an artist could endure.

feed.headline: Ukrainian Drones Close Moscow Airports as Putin Flies Back to Russia
feed.ai: Government planes reported to be carrying the Russian president and his aides home from Turkmenistan were forced to circle or divert to another city.

feed.headline: Trump Says He Will Import Russian Diesel Fuel Amid High Prices
feed.ai: President Trump said Russia had agreed to ship potentially millions of tons of diesel fuel in the coming months. But the amounts would be small relative to global demand.

feed.headline: China and Europe Step Back From Trade War With Limits on Chinese Car Exports
feed.ai: The European Union said the deal could roughly halve shipments of hybrid vehicles from China in the next four years. But it also could lead to an even stronger Chinese auto industry.
